Facebook.description: Settings of the Meta (Facebook) app. These values override the ones configured in the admin settings under Settings > Integrations > Meta App, and they are only applied when the 'ConfigureFacebookSettings()' extension method is called on the OrchardCoreBuilder. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/modules/Facebook/.

AppId.description: The Meta application ID, available under Basic Settings in the Meta for Developers app page.

AppSecret.description: The Meta application secret, available under Basic Settings in the Meta for Developers app page. This is a sensitive value: provide it through user secrets, environment variables or a key vault rather than appsettings.json.

FBInit.description: Whether the Meta JavaScript SDK is initialized on every page, rather than only on the pages that need it.

FBInitParams.description: The comma-separated key-value parameters passed to the FB.init() call, e.g. 'status: true, xfbml: true, autoLogAppEvents: true'.

SdkJs.description: The name of the Meta JavaScript SDK file to load, e.g. 'sdk.js'.

Version.description: The Meta Graph API version used by the JavaScript SDK, in the 'v{major}.{minor}' format, e.g. 'v3.2'.

OrchardCore_Facebook.deprecationMessage: The 'OrchardCore_Facebook' section is deprecated. Use 'OrchardCore:Facebook' instead.
